title: TNT Group broadens its expertise to expand into new markets
summary: Recently acquired by PM Studio Group, TNT Group is set to take its development in the luxury packaging market a step further. A specialist in high-value-added primary and secondary packaging, the company, founded in 2013, is focusing on diversifying its offering, expanding internationally and advancing eco-design. title: Dove launches a fine fragrance inspired by its iconic beauty bar
summary: Dove is turning one of beauty's most recognizable scents into a fine fragrance. The brand has bottled the signature scent of its iconic bar soap in a limited-edition launch. Created in collaboration with fragrance developer Ann Gottlieb, the new fragrance translates the familiar scent of the Dove Original Beauty Bar into a wearable format, with a soft, clean and familiar olfactory profile. title: Silab unveils new efficacy data for Cicactyl in post-laser skin care
summary: Silab, a France-headquartered developer of natural cosmetic active ingredients, has released new efficacy data for Cicactyl, its active ingredient designed to support skin repair following fractional laser procedures. Silab has conducted new efficacy studies for Cicactyl, a natural active ingredient derived from carob gum (Ceratonia siliqua). Cicactyl was developed to accelerate and improve skin healing.
